description: HONEST labeled retrieval-precision corpus for R8. Each query is a paraphrased / conceptual reformulation that is INDEPENDENT of its relevant document's text: the query was authored by hand, not copied from the target. This makes precision@k / recall@k a real semantic-retrieval signal instead of the near-tautological known-item lexical test (query = target title+summary). The system did NOT author these documents from the queries. Independence is enforced at runtime by LocalRagPrecisionCorpusService::queryIndependenceReport() and by a regression test that fails if any query is a substring of (or shares too high a token overlap with) its relevant document text.

independence_contract.rule: query MUST NOT be a substring of any of its relevant documents and MUST share a low Jaccard token overlap with each relevant document (default max 0.34)
independence_contract.rationale: A high overlap would collapse the test back into a lexical known-item match. We assert a hard ceiling so the corpus stays honest even if it is edited later.

documents.text: git revert creates a fresh commit that cancels out an earlier one while keeping the project history intact and never rewriting it.
git reset --hard discards every local modification and forces the working tree to match the remote branch, erasing uncommitted work permanently.
Adding a B-tree on a frequently filtered column lets the planner skip a sequential scan, so lookups on large tables return in milliseconds.
Eager loading related records in a single round trip avoids issuing one extra database call per row when iterating a result set.
The deflated Sharpe ratio penalises a backtest for how many strategies were tried, shrinking the score when an apparent edge is just selection over many trials.
Risking a small fixed fraction of capital on each trade caps the drawdown from any single loser and keeps the account alive through a losing streak.
Reinvesting returns means each period earns on the prior gains too, so wealth grows along an exponential curve rather than a straight line.
The probability of backtest overfitting estimates how often the in-sample winner underperforms the median out of sample, flagging curve-fit research.
Attackers craft messages that impersonate a trusted brand to trick a person into surrendering their login on a lookalike page.
Granting an account only the minimum permissions it needs limits the blast radius when that account is compromised.
Requiring a second factor beyond the password means a stolen credential alone is not enough for an intruder to get in.
Concatenating untrusted input straight into a query lets a hostile user smuggle commands that read or destroy the whole database; bound parameters stop it.
Reviewing material at expanding intervals, just before you would forget it, moves knowledge into long-term memory far more efficiently than cramming.
Long uninterrupted stretches of focus on a single cognitively demanding task produce far more value than the same hours fragmented by context switches.
Skill grows fastest when you work at the edge of your ability on targeted weaknesses with immediate feedback, not by repeating what you already do well.
When a contracted engine suddenly gets much stronger, the governing layer captures that jump automatically and multiplies it with its own compounding, so the whole gets better from the shock.
Before adding a structural capability, identify its canonical owner layer, domain and flow, then extend the existing module instead of creating a parallel runtime.
If the migration ledger says an operation ran but its table is absent, add an idempotent repair migration guarded by schema checks and never edit the ledger manually.
Automated suites must use an isolated disposable database; destructive reset helpers may never connect to the developer's live data store.
Context sent outside the machine contains only redacted provider-safe projections, while sensitive source material remains local and excluded before traversal.
Long-running work preserves every invariant, decision, blocker and open action during compaction, with the raw event log retained separately for deterministic replay.
A hard defect starts with a fast deterministic reproduction that asserts the exact symptom; only after it fails consistently should hypotheses and a fix follow.
Syntax trees, call and data flow, ownership and dependency edges identify affected modules and choose the smallest trustworthy set of tests for a change.
An automated repair loop has a bounded attempt budget, stops when measured quality worsens, rolls back the harmful change and sends the result to an independent judge.
